programmes.show_description: An Autumn Shroud: Crime-cracking action. Dalziel goes on a holiday in East Anglia and finds himself drawn into a conspiracy at a country house. Francesca Annis guest stars.
Safe as Houses: Lord of the Rings star Dominic Monaghan guests in the quirky mystery series. An old friend gives Hetty her most baffling case yet; to help a woman keep her baby.
A Cup O'Kindness: Pearl investigates when a mother takes her daughter out for a boat ride and the pair need rescuing after the craft is sabotaged.
My Brother's Keeper: Sister Reginald's ex-con brother Alfie shows up at the convent. The sisters agree to let him stay, but when an artist is found murdered, all eyes are on Alfie.
Shopping from Home.
Shopping from Home.
Loyalty: Comedy with Chigwell's most famous siblings. The future of the cafe hangs in the balance as Tracey decides whether to put up her house as collateral.
On the Wagon: Is Carver really on the wagon, or have his colleagues reason to doubt him?
New. Face in the Crowd: George is torn between two women claiming to be the mother of the same boy, and Vivien rejects Jimmi's offer of help.
New. Served Cold: Nick treats a man attacked by his wife for being unfaithful, while Melody worries about what happened between Daniel and herself.
Great Expectations: Mickie's midwife mother comes into the ward with a home birth patient, but they find working together difficult. Carlos makes a shocking discovery about Tricia.
Less Than Zero: Nita tries to run away and joins a woman fleeing to Scarborough with her brother. Jay feels stressed after the cancer scare and receives an unwelcome visit from Maryam.
On the Wagon: Is Carver really on the wagon, or have his colleagues reason to doubt him?
New. Zainab takes drastic measures to cut Syed out of her life. Ronnie finds a bit of goodness in her heart and Ian's plans are thwarted when he receives bad news from the bank.
New. Phil is panicked as Louise goes missing. Danny has a wicked plan to take Roxy for all she is worth, and Masood stands up for the most important thing in his life.
In Whom We Trust: Cosy drama in the ageless series based on the real life stories of a Yorkshire vet. An old friend of James and Siegfried's appears to be stealing from them.
Jack and Vanessa's wedding day approaches, and it becomes clear the bride-to-be's brother is a con artist. Meanwhile, Abby is quite happy to accept Sir Edward's money.
Poison Pen: Patricia Routledge takes a break from playing Hyacinth Bucket in the mystery series. While Hetty helps a village, can Robert and Geoffrey solve their own case?
Poetic Justice: Comedy with the Chigwell sisters and their man-mad neighbour. On a prison visit to the Isle of Wight, Dorien finally meets Chris.
In the Service of Humanity: A vintage episode of the comedy about the three naughty old men from Yorkshire. Clegg and Compo are dismayed when Foggy gets into first aid.
Car and Garter: More laughs with the trio of irrepressible oldsters. In order to enhance Sid's marital status, Foggy, Clegg and Compo decide to create a glamorous image for him.
The Odd Dog Men: The world's longest-running sitcom. A chance encounter with an unwilling and resentful dog-walker suggests to Foggy that this might be a business opportunity.
The Cat of Mastigatus: An investigation gets under way when a girl is left for dead at a boys school fete. Mark Williams stars in this drama, based on the stories by GK Chesterton.
Queen of the Kitchen: Celebrity cook, Prunella Gladwell, brings her TV baking show to Great Slaughter. But the programme takes a sour turn when Gladys Tibbs is poisoned by her own cake.
The War Against Drugs: Adventures with those amiable middle-aged sleuths. Brian reluctantly goes into rehab, but is soon investigating the death of a drug addict at the clinic.
Ruling Passion: The smash hit mystery series, from the award-winning novels of Reginald Hill. Pascoe and Ellie go to visit friends in an Oxfordshire village, where murder takes place.
Poison Pen: Patricia Routledge takes a break from playing Hyacinth Bucket in the mystery series. While Hetty helps a village, can Robert and Geoffrey solve their own case?
The Man on the Blue Plaque: When a 30-year-old skeleton with a connection to Pearl washes up in Whitstable, the restauranteur's budding romance with Mike is also threatened.
Scoop: The body of a high-level government official's secretary is found at the bottom of a staircase - and Sister Boniface claims she was dead before the fall.
Shopping from Home.
Shopping from Home.
High Fidelity: More chuckles from Chigwell as Tracey faces a crisis in her marriage when a young man comes calling at her house - the same man Sharon also had her eye on!
The Untouchables: Can Glaze find the connection between a burning man, a girl and a man in a baseball cap?
New. The Transfer Season: Eva investigates when a footballer dies in an apparent armed robbery, and Ruth catches Melody and Daniel in a compromising position.
New. Stranger on a Bridge: A wealthy family friend of Melody is tortured and forced to acknowledge his dark past.
Happy Families: Diane begins her battle for custody of Jack, but just when he's needed more than ever, Owen is nowhere to be found. Mickie endures a tough working day that ends in disaster.
Only Human: An interviewee for an ED job is involved in a traffic accident, Jay learns he has cancer and Ruth escapes from the psychiatric ward.
The Untouchables: Can Glaze find the connection between a burning man, a girl and a man in a baseball cap?
New. Phil takes his anger out on an unsuspecting Jordan. Meanwhile, Roxy stumbles on Danny's mysterious plot, but has she got the wrong idea?
New. Phil learns what has been going on with his children, and hits out with horrible consequences. Meanwhile, the stakes rise when Danny tells Glenda that Ronnie is onto them.
The Rough and the Smooth: Put your feet up and watch the vets on their rounds. Siegfried sings the praises of a new time-management system but has a hard time with a Great Dane.
Jack and Vanessa honeymoon on Malta, while Charles and Lynne find themselves drawn together.
Lost Chords: Patricia Routledge moves on from Mrs Bucket to play the 60-year-old detective. Finalists in the Blainthorp Music Festival mysteriously start losing their voices.
Flavour of the Month: Another slice of Chigwell life with the Essex sisters. Tracey's good deed backfires when she tries to help an ex-con.
A Bicycle Made for Three: Vintage laughs. Finding themselves unexpectedly in a country ditch, Foggy, Clegg and Compo decide that one standard gent's bicycle is not enough.
One of the Last few Places Unexplored by Man: Growing old disgracefully with Compo and friends. Here, Compo wants his photo taken - in Nora Batty's bedroom. Brave man!
Serenade for Tight Jeans and Metal Detector: Whimsical comedy from all our childhood Sunday evenings. Clegg takes to the hills with a metal detector to look for treasure.
New. The Modern Art of Murder: First Chapter: A body is discovered at the opening of a new art gallery, and Mattie's interviews of the suspects don't paint a pretty picture.
The King of Jersey: Bergerac returns for the most challenging case of his career when shocking events unfold at a wedding reception on the island.
The Truth Is Out There: Another case for our favourite middle-aged detectives. The team investigate a cover-up which conspiracy theorists think is linked to a crash-landed UFO.
